test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Walking at the speed of 5 kmph, a man covers a certain distance in 3 hours. Running at a speed of 15 kmph the man will cover the same distance in:
solution:
**Given**

Walking speed = 5 km/hr

Time = 3 hr

Running speed = 15 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation**

Total distance = 5 × 3

⇒ 15 km

 Now if he covers this distance by running at a speed of 15 km /hr then,

⇒ 15 = 15 × time

Time = 1 hour

**∴ Man will cover same distance in 1 hour. **
